pages.text: Smoke any log in a smoker into a $(item)Seasoned Billet$(). With an axe in your off hand, use a billet on the $(item)Chopping Block$() to split it into two $(item)Staves$().
pages.title: Seasoning and splitting

pages.text: Hold a stave and right-click the fletching table. The knife drifts off the grain: tap to nudge it back, and keep it on the grain to the end. It makes $(item)Bow Limbs$(). Bend them in hot water, like fulling cloth, into $(item)Bent Limbs$().
pages.title: Carving and bending
